func_80016950_17550.title: Initialize the current graphics bank
func_80016950_17550.summary: Resets the matrix cursor and lighting state for the selected native graphics bank.
behavior: Selects one of the two graphics banks using the signed16 index D_800C7A72. Each bank starts at the full system pointer plus index × 0x1D6D8.
Sets D_80168504 to that bank’s matrix region and clears D_801684F8 and D_801684FC to zero.
This is the native bank-initialization boundary. Graphics submission toggles the selected bank; world-frame parity does not identify bank ownership when submission is skipped.
cautions: Do not call this to reclaim buffers while rendering or submitted work still owns them.
Resetting a cursor does not enlarge either graphics command or matrix storage.

func_80016C44_17844.title: Draw one native display object
func_80016C44_17844.summary: Applies object visibility and render context before dispatching model drawing.
behavior: Rejects an object when byte +0x64 has bit 0 set, signed byte +0x65 is negative, or the native visibility/culling checks reject it. A nonnegative +0x65, including the reset-template value 1, is accepted by this gate.
Binds the current object through D_801684A0 and dispatches the model command at +0x2C using the material/context word at +0x30 and segment bases beginning at +0x34.

For case-6 model commands whose low bit is zero, sets transform-mode byte D_8016852D to 1. Only this dispatcher writes that mode byte in the inspected executable. The nested skeleton traversal does not recursively call this dispatcher.
A case-6 header with bit 31 set reaches the cached model tree through its root pointer at header +0x08. Signed relative node indices at +0x04 and +0x05 use 24-byte nodes.

The native renderer advances command and matrix cursors without capacity checks. CPU model-cache capacity, final graphics-bank storage, and the 16-entry temporary transform stack are separate constraints.
cautions: object must be a valid native display record with resident model and segment resources. Calling this from arbitrary gameplay code does not establish render context.
A general model or inline material list can require an unbounded number of commands. Any preflight bound must constrain the accepted model/material path and validate tree offsets, cycles and depth.
func_80016C44_17844.returns: Zero when visibility or native culling rejects the object; one when the native object path is processed. This is not proof that a GPU submission has completed.

D_800C7A72_C8672.title: Current native graphics-bank index
D_800C7A72_C8672.summary: Signed16 selector for the two native graphics banks.
behavior: The verified bank values are 0 and 1. The full system structure contains the two 0x1D6D8-byte bank records consecutively at its beginning.
The frame-submission path toggles this index only when graphics are submitted. func_80016950 initializes the selected bank before its next use.
cautions: This selector is distinct from the world-frame counter. Do not infer bank reuse from a frame counter or overwrite the selector while work is in flight.

D_8015C5CC_15D1CC.title: Current graphics-command cursor
D_8015C5CC_15D1CC.summary: Pointer to the next native 8-byte graphics command.
behavior: Native render writers append two 32-bit words per Gfx command and advance this pointer. A stock bank contains 10,640 commands at its beginning.
The pointer is live mutable cursor state; the bank base comes from the full system pointer and current bank index. The writers do not enforce the bank’s command-array bound.

Commands and every referenced matrix or data range must retain storage until the owning graphics bank is reusable. Redirecting CPU pointers alone does not make extended-heap addresses valid for RSP data.
cautions: This is pointer storage, not a Gfx array symbol. Do not insert commands or redirect it without preserving renderer context, address encoding, capacity and submission lifetime.

D_80168504_169104.title: Current graphics-matrix cursor
D_80168504_169104.summary: Pointer to the next 64-byte fixed-point matrix submitted by native rendering.
behavior: func_80016950 resets this pointer to the selected bank’s matrix array at bank offset 0x14C80. The stock array contains 540 matrices of 64 bytes each.
Native transform writers advance this cursor without checking its end. Per-node billboard handling can consume three submitted matrices; root transforms and camera setup consume additional matrices.
This final fixed-point matrix storage is separate from kind-2 CPU model caches and the native temporary floating-point transform stack.
cautions: A matrix pointer may be emitted into a display list. Its data must use an address accepted by the graphics path and remain unchanged until that bank is reusable.
Expanding CPU record storage or a capacity scalar does not expand the matrix array.

D_801684F8_1690F8.title: Native lighting accumulation state
D_801684F8_1690F8.summary: Signed32 lighting state used while preparing the current graphics bank.
behavior: func_80016950 resets this state to zero. Native lighting setup uses it while accumulating lighting work and marks it -1 after the pending state has been applied.
It participates in command emission alongside the separate active-light count D_801684FC. It is not a model count or a graphics-bank capacity.
cautions: Only the reset and applied marker are established here. Other numeric values retain native accumulation semantics and are not a complete enum.
A custom command preflight must account for light emission; do not treat this state as an independent lighting override.

D_801684FC_1690FC.title: Native active-light count
D_801684FC_1690FC.summary: Signed32 active-light count consumed by native render setup.
behavior: func_80016950 resets this count to zero at graphics-bank initialization. Native lighting setup uses the active entries when emitting graphics commands.
This count contributes to graphics-command cost. It is separate from the accumulation/applied state in D_801684F8.
cautions: Read under the corresponding rendering lifecycle. A custom renderer must validate the count against its verified lighting storage and command budget before using it.
